info.subtitle: 328,994,783 Open Ports or ping from November 2022
info.description:
# Content

328,994,783 Open Ports or ping from November 2022. Port scanned using [Masscan](https://github.com/robertdavidgraham/masscan)

Only Ping and Port 23 (Telnet).



# Notes
This scan was targeted at 0.0.0.0/0 (the entire IPv4 address space) minus the IP ranges found in [Masscan's default exclusion file](https://github.com/robertdavidgraham/masscan/blob/master/data/exclude.conf). This removed private IP ranges and ranges belonging to various organizations who have complained about Masscan in the past.
